bswai...@my-deja.com wrote:
> If Anachronism is placed on a Vampire are all ranged weapons he
> acquires
> thereafter immediately burned? What about if he steals a weapon during
> combat, plays disguised weapon, or gets an "illusionary" weapon with
> Horrid Reality? Instantly gone?

All ranged weapons (except the Ivory Bow) are burned as soon as
the Anachronistic vampire takes possession of them.
